title: Korea raises data breach fines to 10% of revenue
summary: South Korea has amended its data protection laws to raise fines for data breaches to as much as 10% of a company's revenue, significantly strengthening penalties for mishandling personal information. The move mirrors global regulatory trends like the EU's GDPR and signals growing pressure on tech and AI companies to secure user data. Hacker News discussion focuses on enforcement, compliance costs, and implications for AI firms handling large datasets.
